info.title: Sloto - Appointment Booking API
info.description: REST API for customers, providers/staff and admins. Authenticate with POST /api/auth/login and send 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>'.

delete.summary: Cancel with reason; refund per policy (FR-29, FR-39)

patch.summary: Reschedule (FR-28): subject to cut-off and maximum reschedules

put.summary: Profile, timezone, slot rules (interval, per-day / per-slot limits) and policies (FR-13, FR-16, FR-17)
Replace the weekly schedule (provider level, or one staff member)
Change password; other sessions are signed out and new tokens returned
Provider/staff: CONFIRMED, CANCELLED (reject, needs reason), COMPLETED, NO_SHOW (FR-30, FR-31)
Update a service; a different providerId re-assigns it
Approve (VERIFIED), reject or suspend a provider

post.summary: Upload an image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, max 2 MB)
Lock a slot for 10 minutes during checkout
Rate (1-5) and review a completed appointment (FR-41, FR-42)
Report a review for moderation
Add a staff member; with an e-mail, a STAFF login is created and a set-password link sent
Record the amount collected at the venue
Razorpay webhook (signed with the webhook secret)
Verify the Razorpay checkout signature and confirm the booking
Development only (payments demo mode): simulate a successful checkout
Create a Razorpay order for an unpaid booking (full amount or deposit)
Add a weekly window (FR-14)
Block a date / time range (holiday, leave) or set custom hours for a date (FR-15)
Verify e-mail or phone with the code (FR-2)
Public e-mail verification with e-mail + code
Send an e-mail or SMS verification code (FR-2)
Set a new password using the token from the reset link
Register a customer or provider (FR-1); an e-mail verification code is sent
Exchange a refresh token for new tokens
Revoke all tokens of the current user (FR-7)
Login with e-mail/password; returns access + refresh JWT (FR-3)
Sign in with a Google ID token (FR-6)
E-mail a password reset link (FR-4)
Book an appointment (FR-21..26). Race-safe: the slot is re-checked under a lock
Create a service and assign it to a provider (providerId)
Assign (copy) this service to another provider

get.summary: Real-time slots for provider + service (+ staff) on a date
Browse / search services (FR-18): q, categoryId, providerId, minPrice, maxPrice, mode, city, sort
Search providers: q (service/provider/location), categoryId, city, minRating, minPrice, maxPrice, serviceId, date, mode, sort
Provider profile with services, staff, branches, rating and policy (FR-13)
Real-time slots for a date (FR-20). serviceId defaults to the provider's first service
Preview a coupon discount (does not consume it)
Public client configuration (feature flags, public keys)
Policy check before cancelling: allowed? refund amount?
My appointments; scope = upcoming | past | cancelled | all (FR-27)
Revenue, bookings, cancellations and peak hours for a date range
Export appointments as CSV or PDF (FR-47)

delete.summary: Delete (anonymise) a user; booking history is kept
